en:
Because... I don't have any other friends at school. They
said they'd ignore me if I didn't go on a paid date...
Some friends. You'd be much better off without them.

But... If I didn't do what they said, they would bully me at
school! They'd hit me, and cut up my uniform, and...

Kazumi! How long are ya gonna talk to that geezer? We gotta
find us another john. C'mon! We're goin'!
If you don't earn enough, how're we supposed to party?

I'm sorry, did I hear that right? You want Kazumi to sell
herself so you can goof off?
That's got to be a new low. I'd love to meet your parents.

Hmph. What do you know? How about I introduce you to my big
brother instead?

Hey, what's up, Emi? Kazumi was gonna earn some money today,
yeah? You run into trouble or what?

This geezer's gettin' in the way. Keeps spewin' grade-school
morality bullshit and holdin' things up.

Huh? What's the matter, old man? You got a problem with my
lil' sis? Why don't ya take it up with me, then?

Hmm. Let me get this straight. You're really Emi-chan's
older brother?

What, you pissin' yourself now? That's what ya get for
thinkin' you can boss us around.

Mister, you should run. They're capable of anything when
they're mad...

Run? Why? I'm rather pleased that they came along. Perfect
timing, actually.

Your little sister was really starting to piss me off, but I
have this thing against hitting women, so frankly, I wasn't
sure what to do.

But now that you're here, well, problem solved, wouldn't you
say?

Real funny, old man. You're not from around these parts, are
ya? You don't know who you're dealin' with.

Bro, hurry up, and stomp this asshole! Tryna find more johns
is too much work! We'll just take his wallet after you're
done with him!

Come on, Kazumi-chan, what's your problem? Ya can't back out
now.

Please, I decided I don't want to anymore. I want to go
home!

Now, hold on, you're bein' unreasonable. I went through all
this trouble of comin' to see ya. Junior here's not about to
be blue-balled.

Hey, pal, have a heart, huh? You'd really force a girl into
a place like this?
What? Who the hell are you?

I believe the girl said no. Tell Junior there to calm down,
and get out while you still have teeth.
You stay out of this! Ain't none of your business!

Look, this is a paid relationship deal, isn't it? And with
a minor, no less. That's grounds for arrest, you know?
Shut your yap! I told ya to scram!
Come on, baby, quit stallin'!
No! I don't want to!
(There's that paid relationship couple.)
Thank you so much for doin' that, Haruka!
Oh, no, I was glad to!

I've never seen so many customers linin' up! Ya sure can
draw a crowd!

And they all seemed over the moon to shake your hand! I'd
wager I'm gonna have a whole slew of new regulars, thanks to
you!

This a great success, if ya ask me. I better roll up my
sleeves tomorrow, 'cause it looks like I'm gonna be busy! Thank you, Haruka!
I'm just happy I could help!

Here's your reward for bein' my "manager for a day"! I threw
in a little extra, too!
Wha⑬? Are you sure? Thank you very much!

And they all seemed pretty pleased to shake your hand! They
liked my takoyaki, too, so, frankly, I couldn't be happier!
Thank you, Haruka!

Here's a little reward for bein' my "manager for a day"!
Wish it could be more.

It's me who should be thankin' you! You really gave Magutako
a boost today. I hope you'll be back!

All right, folks! Today, we have a very special guest here
at Magutako, singer Haruka Sawamura-chan! She's agreed to be my
"manager for a day"!

Try our special bargain, a sampler three-pack of takoyaki!
Only one hundred yen!

Each lucky person who buys takoyaki today will receive a
warm handshake from our special "manager for a day," Haruka!

Step on up and try this takoyaki, everyone! It's absolutely
delicious!
I'll take a pack!

Hey, you're Haruka-chan from the Princess League! I wanna
shake your hand!
Mommy, can I shake Haruka-chan's hand, too?
I'll take some takoyaki!

Whaddya say, Haruka-chan? How about some nice, warm
handshakes for our wonderful new customers?
(Should I go over the handshake procedure before I get started?)
(Yes, I think I'd better, just in case.)
(Let's see. Have I got it now?)
(Hmm. I think I'd better run through it one more time, just to be safe.)

(I think I'm all set now. I'd better get started on the
handshakes!)

(I guess I don't need to. I'd better get started on the
handshakes!)
Huh? Uh, miss? Excuse me!

Aren't you Haruka-chan, that big idol from TV? I'd recognize
that face anywhere!

Mhm, that's right. I'm Haruka Sawamura. Thank you so much
for watching!

Well, would you look at that? A famous star like you just
strollin' down the street!
Hey, I know! Why not try some of my takoyaki before ya go?
Me? But⑬

Haha! Don't worry! It's on the house! As you can see, it's
not exactly busy here. In a bit of a slump, ya might say.

I just can't understand it 'cause my takoyaki is really
good. Care to give it a try?
Oh, um, not right now, thank you, but definitely next time!
You promise? Okay, I'll be waitin' for ya!
All right, I'll try some.

There's a good girl! Here ya go. Real Magutako takoyaki!
Nothin' more "Osaka" than this!
So, whaddya think? Good, right?

See? What'd I tell ya? Best in the city, if I do say so
myself. I just can't figure out why people ain't linin' up
to come get it!

Maybe I gotta advertise more or spruce up my stand or
somethin'? I tell ya, I'm stumped!

Ya think so? Well, that's awfully kind of ya to say. Thank
you, Haruka-chan!

Hey, if ya ever get a chance, maybe you can talk this place
up on TV!

Oh, I don't know. I don't get many chances to say whatever I
want on TV...

Haha! Aw, I'm just pullin' your leg. You're an idol, after
all. It's not like you're a comedian or anything!

Hey, I know! Wanna be my "manager for a day"? If you'd do
that for me, I can't tell ya how much I'd appreciate it!
Manager for a day? What would you have me do?

Hmm, I dunno... Just stand in front of the shop, maybe? That
oughta do the trick!
But would that really draw in customers, do you think?
Wouldn't it? I know it'd get me to stop by.
I can shake hands with whomever buys your takoyaki.

Of course! Oh, but wait. I'd better check with my agency to
make sure it's all right. I don't think they'll have any
objections, though.
That'd be fantastic!

They said yes. They thought it would be a great idea to help
out a local business.
They did!? Wonderful! I'll start gettin' ready right away!
The mixer was a big success thanks to you, Suzuki-san! You're the man! Here, I want to give you this as my way of saying thanks.
You got a <Color:8>Calming Towel<Color:Default>.
So... How did you like our get-together today?
It was super fun... Although, you're a bit too young for me to take you seriously. Still, we should do this again sometime!
Yeah, I had a blast! Gyahawhawhaw!
I had a really great time, too. Thank you for having us.
Oh, not at all! Thank <Italic>you</Italic>!
We survived that mixer unscathed thanks to you, Suzuki-san. Here, this is for you.
Ah, I thought it was all right. Pretty average, really.
For real! *chortle*
That's not a very nice thing to say. I'd just like to say thank you.
Oh, well, uh... Thank <Italic>you</Italic>!
So I guess you're not that great at mixers, huh, Suzuki-san? I know it was my idea and all... but you kind of ruined the whole thing.
It was absolute hell! I mean, like, who do you guys think you are!? I'm never going out with you again!
Stick it to 'em, girl! *chortle*
Kondo-san... You're too good to us.
Welp, time for our appointment at the beauty salon. We're outtie! Bye!
I'd better go, too. So long.
Kondo-san...
If I just let her leave, nothing will change... I have to gather up my courage and tell her how I feel!
Yeah! You're right! You can do this!
Hey, uh⑬ Kondo-san!
Listen, we, um...
If you don't mind, maybe we could like... grab some tea, or...
Oh, hold on.
*buzz* *buzz*
Oh, hello? Is that you, Ryo-kun? Why didn't you call me yesterday? I missed you!
What am I doing now? I got dragged to a co-worker's mixer because she needed a third girl. Don't worry, nothing happened.
I'm telling you the truth. I wouldn't do that. You're the only one for me, Ryo-kun. Teehee.
Huh? Now? Sure, I'm free. I'll see you at your place, then. I'll buy some beer on the way. See you soon, sweetie.
I'm sorry about that. What was it you were saying?
Nothing... We were just saying bye.
Okay. Thanks again for taking me out!
...They're just full of surprises, aren't they?
Tell me about it... I think I've had enough of the dating game for now.
Same here. Let's just focus on work. At least our taxis will always love us.
Oh, hey, what are the boys up to tonight?
You missed out, Wada-san.
We just had a mixer, and Kiyokawa and Muramatsu-san are still reeling from the rejection.

Ouch. Sorry to hear that, gents. I guess you guys are gonna
want to come along, then?
Come along where?
To the cabaret club, of course! Going after regular girls will only get your heart ripped out. Mixers are a waste of time!
I dunno... Cabaret clubs aren't really my thing.

Oh, don't be such a stick in the mud! Cabarets are the best!
Where else can you go and have a beautiful woman pour you
drinks, light your smoke, and listen to all your bullshit?
I've been single all my life, and sure, it gets lonely at times. But thanks to cabaret clubs and the wonderful ladies who work there, I've made it where I am today.
You're single, Wada-san!?
Forget about that⑬let's just head to a club already! Tab's on me tonight. Time to buy us some love and affection!
Well, when you put it that way, I'm in! Hehe, now I'm actually glad we did that mixer!
Yeah, you sure convinced me. Now show us how it's done! Oh, and see you around, Suzuki-san!
(Heh. Leave it to a cabaret club to cheer up two lonely men. I guess all's well that ends well.)

Oh, hey, Suzuki-san! Could you help us out after all?
We could really use another mixer buddy.
Okay, I'll help out if I can.

Great! That makes an even count, and now we have an absolute
ladykiller on our side! Now quick, hook us up with advice!

Really? Well... That's too bad. I guess, let me know if you
decide to change your mind? But dang, what are we gonna do
now?
Well hey! What's new, Suzuki-san?

Oh, Kiyokawa? And Muramatsu-san? What are you two up to?
Out for some dinner?
Nope! We are going... to a mixer!
A mixer?
Yeah, one of those group date sort of things! See, I met this girl online, and she agreed to meet me with some of her friends!
Hehe, who knows? Today could be the day I finally get myself a girlfriend!
Oh yeah... <Italic>Oh yeah!</Italic> Wahahaha!
Huh. Kiyokawa going to a mixer, that I can understand. But I never imagined you'd want to tag along.
Oh, it's not like I wanted to go. This horndog here practically begged me to join him.
Come on, Muramatsu-san! When we were out drinking the other day, you were crying in your beer, saying you didn't want to die a virgin!
Hey, you promised never to mention that!
Ahem... All I'm trying to get at is, if today's mixer goes well, we can kiss our lonely days goodbye!
You think the two of us can actually pull this off? To be honest, I'm not all that sure I can keep a woman entertained the whole evening.
Yeah, come to think of it, I'm not much of a smooth talker myself. I always end up trying too hard. What do we do?

Besides, aren't there three of them on their way? We're one
man short. Won't they be pissed off?
I guess that could be a problem. But it's not like we've got anyone else we could invite.
...Well, good luck. I better get going.
Oh, wait! Hold up, Suzuki-san!
...What?
Could you, uh... join us at the mixer?
I bet you're pretty suave with the ladies. At this rate, we're destined to mess things up. But if you came along, you could pass your worldly wisdom on to us!
Yeah. I hate asking for help, but fighting a losing battle is even worse. Will you come with us, Suzuki-san?
Okay, I'll help you guys out. Assuming that I can.
Okay, the girls should show up soon.
So this girl you know who's arranging things⑬what's she like? Is she cute?
I met her online, so I haven't seen her face yet. She said people tell her all the time she looks like a famous idol, though.
Plus her writing style's cute, and she likes to bake. I think I might have found the one!
